148529.overview:
You've a terrible headache and the only thing you remember is that you've an appointment at 7th Avenue in Segur where you have to be before 9:10.

The game starts at 8:30 (type REGARDER MONTRE to see the time on your watch). To solve the game you must reach your destination within 40 turns.

148530.overview: Coloric is a puzzle game played on a 7x10 grid of boxes. Each box has a colour and the objective of the game is to change all the boxes into a single specific colour. This is done by simply moving a cursor over the grid and the colours will automatically change. A grid is however not allowed to change to black and if it does the game will end. This means that the player has to avoid moving over the boxes whose colour transforms into black. On the right side of the screen is a chart that shows how colours will be changed when moved over. To make things more challenging, the chart changes over time, and it's necessary to keep track of the changes. There is also a time limit that each level has to be completed within.

148532.overview: A French Pac-Man clone that included the hidden center tunnel.

148555.overview: Pillage Cosmique is a variant of the arcade game Cosmic Guerilla. It is a fixed screen shoot 'em up where the player has to stop the alien invaders that attempt to steal the fuel canisters and space ships located in the centre of the screen. The aliens start from the sides of the screen and move towards the centre where they pick up the objects and return back to where they came from. The player's task is to shoot them down before they are able to escape. If an alien is shot while carrying an object it will return to its original position. If one of the space ships are stolen, the player will lose a life. A life is also lost when hit by the projectiles dropped by the aliens. In addition to the regular aliens there are also saucers and space monsters to watch out for.
